description: This file defines an abstract factory class responsible for creating AnnotationBasedJsonParsable instances from annotations. It outlines the core methods for extracting deserialization keys and method names from annotations, facilitating JSON parsing based on annotations within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AbstractAnnotationBasedJsonParsableFactory
classes.description: An abstract class for factories that create AnnotationBasedJsonParsable objects from annotations, parameterized by the target type T and annotation type A.

methods.name: fromAnnotation
methods.description: Constructs an AnnotationBasedJsonParsable instance using information extracted from the provided annotation and class to parse.

methods.name: getV1FallbackKeyFor
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return the fallback key for V1 deserialization strategies based on the annotation.

methods.name: getKeyFor
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return the key for V2 deserialization strategies based on the annotation.

methods.name: getMethodNameFor
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to determine the method name used for deserialization from the annotation.
